description: Fork of exp332 (tiny LUT-LM, 34.80 M, val_bpb @ 8K = 1.6788). Single trade: v_tph 8 -> 32 (4x). Per-layer v_lut params 196K -> 786K; 6 layers 1.18M -> 4.72M; total 34.80 -> ~38.34 M. Step-by-step pumping continues: residual_tph 8x (exp330), out_tph 2x (exp331), qkv_tph 2x (exp332), now v_tph 4x. Adds capacity to the deep-NAP v_lut (which has NAP=8 vs the shallow NAP=6 v_branch in qkv_lut). Bandwidth impact negligible: layer LUT reads go 0.67M -> 0.71M bits (still 40x less than vanilla's 28.3M layer matmuls).
